LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Enlist_Letter_Label: Your colony now stands with the Companions. Open the guild ledger at any settlement hosting them to draw pay, take work and see your standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Enlist_Button_Desc: Prove your worth to the Companions and earn a place at Jorrvaskr's table.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Enlist_Requrements_Not_S: The Companions does not trust you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Fact: You cannot join the Companions while your colony is at odds with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Missions_Desc: See what work the guild has posted.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Menu_Missions_Desc: Open contracts posted by the Companions. Accepting one costs nothing; payment comes when it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Salary_Desc: Collect your share from the guild's steward.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Provisions_Desc: Take what the guild sets aside for its members on the road.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the guild's keeping and collect them from any hall.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Companions? Your standing will suffer for it.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Resign_Letter_Label: Your colony has left the Companions. Its doors are closed to you for now.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Resign_Button_Desc: Give up your membership and every rank that goes with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Kick_Out_Label_Title: Relations have fallen too far. The Companions has struck your colony from its books.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Work_0_Desc: Clear wolves and settle grudges for whoever pays.
LanguageData.ESCP_Companions_Work_1_Desc: Trade blows behind Jorrvaskr until someone falls down.
